purpose: Data-driven held-out model analysis figure for manuscript revision.
source_rule: Only validation_results/{subject}/reproduce_0866_{subject}/ fixed held-out outputs are used.
sd_reporting_note: The existing manuscript summary reports 0.042, which matches the population standard deviation of the six fc_r.txt values. The sample SD is 0.046; the figure labels only the six-subject mean to avoid adding a new SD convention.
representative_subject_rule: subject whose FC reconstruction r is closest to the six-subject held-out mean
representative_subject_ec_distribution_p: Panel f shows the central 99% of off-diagonal EC values for the representative subject. It intentionally does not report EC-FC correlation because the manuscript correlation uses the fixed reproduce0866_fc_pc_comparison pipeline.
interpretation_boundary: This is a descriptive model-analysis figure. It is not a training-loss curve, not external validation, and not biological ground truth.
